sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.SKU AS sku, p.ProductName AS name, p.Brand AS brand FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState ps ON ps.PublishStateId = p.PublishStateId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory i ON i.SKU = p.SKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId = i.WarehouseId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = pw.PortalId WHERE p.ProductType = @productType AND p.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.PublishStateCode = @publishState AND p.Brand IS NOT NULL AND p.Brand <> @brand AND po.StoreCode = @store GROUP BY p.SKU, p.ProductName, p.Brand HAVING SUM(i.Quantity) >= @minStock ORDER BY p.SKU
